findings.heading: Packages from Github / Пакеты с Github
findings.proposition: The English states the chunk below installs exactly TWO packages from Github ('commands to install two packages'); the Russian drops the cardinality and says only 'commands to install packages from Github repositories'.
findings.reader_consequence: A Russian reader loses the explicit count that tells them the following chunk is complete at two install calls, so they cannot tell from the sentence alone whether the two bullets below enumerate the whole set or only examples of a longer Github list.
